name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: App compatibility. Phone and tablet apps (Jellyfin for Android, Findroid, Swiftfin on iPhone and iPad, Streamyfin) now get a friend-converted stream held to 1080p and about 12 Mbps. Before, these apps sent no resolution limit, so a 4K HDR title became a 4K, 30+ Mbps conversion that a friend's server could make slower than real time, and the Android player gave up with a Source error before the first segment. TV apps and the web client are unchanged, and an app's own resolution limit is respected. Includes everything in 0.0.201.
